title: A user with no grants lands on an app page of "You don't have access" tiles — the console's default landing should explain that the user needs access, and Create User could offer a permission set (hotcrm#2194 T2-U19, the platform half)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 没有任何授权的新用户首次登录，看到的是一屏「无权访问」磁贴。
- **要做：** 平台的默认落地页对无授权用户说明「需要管理员授予访问权限」；新建用户时可顺带选一个权限集。HotCRM 那一半另立卡，等本卡。
- **完成标准：** 无授权用户首屏是说明页，而不是错误磁贴。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T2-U19 (the platform half)**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** first sign-in of a new user who holds no permission set (measured on HotCRM).
- **Now:** the user lands on an app dashboard where every tile says "You don't have access". The first screen a new hire sees is 6 error tiles.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/REPORT.md), U-19; [`07-people-users-newuser-landing.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/07-people-users-newuser-landing.png). Re-measured unchanged on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 by the round 2 pass ([round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), the section's opening paragraph).

## Landing

- The console's default landing (objectui) for a signed-in user who can read nothing in the app it would open, and Setup → Users → Create User (`packages/platform-objects` identity actions) for the optional permission-set pick.
- Context the claim reads first: #25083 and #25295 (a cloud-managed environment hides `create_user` and invites elsewhere), and objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2231 (closed: HotCRM's `crm_user` is the package's `isDefault` set, so an accepted suggestion grants every member).
- The HotCRM half (stop claiming the landing for such a user) is filed on objectstack-ai/hotcrm `pm:blocked` on this card.

## Done when

- A user who can read nothing in the app they would land on sees one page that says they need access and whom to ask, not a grid of refusals.
- Where Create User is offered, it can assign a permission set in the same step; under a cloud-managed environment nothing changes (#25295).
- Pins on the landing decision and on the create path.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectstack issue (108) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (544, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `landing`, `first sign`, `no grant`, `no access`, `create user`. 1 open hit: #8249 (type-axis worklist), not on point; #24936 (closed, Create User's result dialog) is a different defect. **New.**
